title: OKX promo code: what new users should know

scenes.title: OKX promo code
scenes.sub: What new users can actually enter

lines.show: For new users, the OKX promo code you enter at sign-up is a referral code.
There's no separate coupon box to fill in.
People expect a coupon field like an online shop.

scenes.title: One field: the referral code
scenes.text: Promotions live in the rewards page.

lines.show: On OKX, the only code you type is the referral or invite code.
Promotions for new users are listed in the app's rewards page, with their own terms.
It asks you to send a deposit first.
It asks for your password or login code.
It comes from an unknown site or link.
The code shared in this video is XOACPQFC.
Put it in the referral field when you sign up.

scenes.title: If OKX is available where you live

lines.show: If OKX is available where you live, enter XOACPQFC at sign-up, then read the rewards page.
